identities.description: A fictional personal-finance education channel for the CreatorJobs demo marketplace.
A fictional creator agency representing education, technology, and lifestyle channels.
A fictional podcast network producing thoughtful founder and culture interviews.
A fictional gaming creator covering design, speedruns, and indie releases.
A fictional Hindi education channel publishing evidence-led explainers.
A fictional production house creating science and technology films.
A fictional creator-led media business documenting practical company-building lessons.
A fictional consumer food brand producing practical home-cooking content.
A fictional influencer-marketing agency coordinating transparent creator campaigns.
A fictional travel media studio publishing slow, practical destination guides.

jobs.title: Long-form YouTube editor for evidence-led finance stories
jobs.about: Money & Mindset turns personal-finance questions into calm, sourced videos. The editor will shape presenter footage, screen recordings, and simple motion into clear 10–14 minute stories.
responsibilities: Build a strong cold open and coherent story arc
Edit presenter footage, B-roll, captions, music, and sound design
Use retention notes to propose specific pacing improvements
requirements: A portfolio showing narrative long-form edits
Comfort editing factual or educational material

engagement.timezone_overlap: At least 2 hours with IST on review days

deliverables.notes: 10–14 minute edits with captions and light motion.

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Read-only analytics access is granted after onboarding and can be revoked at any time.

autonomy.notes: Bring pacing ideas while preserving the channel's restrained visual language.

trial.scope: Edit a 60–90 second segment from supplied demo footage.

application.how_to_apply: Share one comparable explainer, identify what you edited, and note your normal review cadence.

screening.prompt: Which portfolio edit best shows your approach to retention without over-editing?
How do you use viewer-retention data after a video ships?

jobs.title: Short-form editor for a daily science Shorts series
jobs.about: Northstar is staffing a fictional science creator's vertical desk. The work turns long interviews and demonstrations into useful 30–55 second Shorts without relying on clickbait captions.
responsibilities: Find self-contained hooks in supplied long-form footage
Cut platform-native versions for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok
Deliver captioned masters and clean project files
requirements: A reel of short-form editorial work
Strong caption timing and mobile composition
Ability to deliver consistent batches each week

deliverables.notes: Three platform-safe aspect and caption variants included.

application.how_to_apply: Send three short-form examples and explain how you keep captions readable on small screens.

screening.prompt: What is your reliable weekly batch capacity?

jobs.title: Podcast video editor for a weekly founder interview show
jobs.about: Harborlight produces a weekly interview series with practical, unpolished conversations. We need an editor who can clean four camera feeds, protect the guest's meaning, and hand off clips with dependable naming.
responsibilities: Sync and edit four camera feeds and isolated audio
Remove avoidable repetition while preserving natural conversation
Export the full episode, clips, captions, and organized archive
requirements: Confident dialogue cleanup and loudness delivery
Clear project organization for repeatable handoffs

deliverables.notes: 45–70 minute video episode.
Captioned 30–75 second clips.

application.how_to_apply: Share one long interview edit and describe your sync, cleanup, and archive workflow.

jobs.title: Thumbnail designer for technology reviews and comparisons
jobs.about: Northstar represents a fictional technology review channel that publishes two considered videos each week. The designer will explore distinct concepts before polishing the selected direction.
responsibilities: Translate each video brief into three meaningfully different concepts
Prepare clean layered source files and platform-ready exports
Participate in a short post-publish packaging review
requirements: A YouTube thumbnail portfolio with concept rationale
Fast response to one consolidated review round

deliverables.notes: Three rough concepts, then one production master per upload.

trial.scope: Create one low-resolution rough concept from a supplied fictional brief; no production-ready file is requested.
trial.notes: The concept will not be published or adapted for commercial use.

application.how_to_apply: Use the fictional Northstar demo form and include two concepts that began from the same brief.

screening.prompt: How do you decide whether two thumbnail concepts are genuinely different?

jobs.title: Motion graphics designer for reusable science explainers
jobs.about: Orbit Eight Studio is building a restrained motion toolkit for a fictional science series. The assignment covers reusable callouts, diagrams, lower thirds, and a small transition system rather than one-off spectacle.
responsibilities: Translate static boards into a cohesive motion system
Build editable templates with documented controls
Deliver examples showing the system across three science topics
requirements: A reel with information-led motion design
Ability to simplify complex visual ideas

deliverables.notes: A documented toolkit containing 12 reusable animation components.

trial.scope: Animate one supplied diagram board using temporary assets.

application.how_to_apply: Share a template-based project and explain how another editor safely customized it.

screening.prompt: Which controls would you expose to keep a reusable motion system safe?

jobs.title: Hindi scriptwriter for clear 8–10 minute explainers
jobs.about: Edu Hindi publishes sourced explainers for viewers who prefer conversational Hindi. We need a writer who can read English-language research, test claims, and produce natural spoken scripts without translating sentence by sentence.
responsibilities: Research each assigned question using credible sources
Write hooks, story beats, examples, and source notes
Revise for spoken clarity after an editorial read-through

deliverables.notes: Each supports an 8–10 minute narrated video.

application.how_to_apply: Share a Hindi writing sample and a short note on how you fact-check English source material.

screening.prompt: How would you make a technical phrase feel natural when spoken in Hindi?

jobs.title: Researcher for responsible destination mini-documentaries
jobs.about: Roamline is developing short documentaries that explain how places work beyond a visitor checklist. Research briefs must distinguish verified facts, local perspectives, and open questions for the production team.
responsibilities: Build annotated research briefs with primary and local sources
Flag contested claims and missing context
Suggest interview leads without collecting private contact details
requirements: Strong source evaluation and citation habits
Experience researching culture, policy, or history
Concise briefing that a writer can use immediately

deliverables.notes: One 8–12 page brief and one source ledger per destination.

application.how_to_apply: Share one source-led brief or outline and describe how you mark uncertainty.

screening.prompt: How do you handle two credible sources that disagree?

jobs.title: Voice-over artist for a calm personal-finance audio series
jobs.about: Money & Mindset is testing a companion audio series built from original educational scripts. The voice should feel measured and trustworthy, with clean edits and consistent pronunciation across recurring financial terms.
responsibilities: Record clean narration from approved scripts
Deliver lightly edited WAV masters and pickup files
Maintain a pronunciation sheet across episodes
requirements: A treated recording space and broadcast-quality microphone
Reliable pickups within one business day

deliverables.notes: Each master is approximately 8–12 finished minutes.

revision.notes: One pickup round for pronunciation or performance notes.

application.how_to_apply: Send a clean narration reel and note the microphone, room treatment, and delivery format you use.

screening.prompt: How do you keep recurring technical terms consistent across episodes?

jobs.title: YouTube channel strategist for founder case studies
jobs.about: Startup Stories publishes practical case studies with a small in-house production team. We need a strategist to turn audience questions and performance signals into a clear monthly slate, not simply chase trending topics.
responsibilities: Develop a monthly topic and packaging slate
Run a weekly performance review with documented decisions
Brief writers and thumbnail designers on the audience promise
requirements: Channel strategy work with measurable learning loops
Ability to interpret traffic and retention reports
Clear briefs that production teams can act on

engagement.timezone_overlap: Two hours with IST on Tuesdays and Thursdays

deliverables.notes: Topic slate, packaging hypotheses, and learning agenda.
Performance review with next actions.

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Read-only YouTube analytics access is limited to the strategy period; no passwords are shared.

application.how_to_apply: Describe one channel decision you changed after reviewing performance data.

screening.prompt: What would you review before recommending more of a high-view but low-subscriber format?

jobs.title: Full-time channel manager for an indie gaming creator
jobs.about: Indie Gamer is moving from ad-hoc uploads to a dependable weekly schedule. This role owns the publishing calendar, production handoffs, metadata QA, sponsor checkpoints, and respectful coordination with freelance specialists.
responsibilities: Own the weekly production board and publishing checklist
Coordinate editor, thumbnail, sponsor, and creator handoffs
Monitor upload health and document operational improvements
requirements: Experience operating a creator or media production calendar
Excellent written follow-up and risk escalation
Comfort with YouTube Studio and shared account controls

deliverables.notes: Calendar, QA checklist, sponsor checkpoints, and retro.

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Role-based access is granted after onboarding with two-factor authentication; personal credentials are never requested.

application.how_to_apply: Share an example of a production system you improved and how you handled a missed handoff.

screening.prompt: How would you recover a sponsored upload when an edit is one day late?

jobs.title: Part-time social media manager for practical cooking videos
jobs.about: Goodgrain Kitchen publishes tested recipes for busy home cooks. The manager will schedule finished assets, adapt captions by platform, coordinate comment handoffs, and report what audiences actually save or recreate.
responsibilities: Plan and schedule the weekly cross-platform calendar
Adapt captions and covers without changing tested recipe claims
Summarize audience questions and content signals each Friday
requirements: Hands-on Instagram and TikTok publishing experience
Strong copy judgment for food content

engagement.timezone_overlap: Three Bengaluru office afternoons per month

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Publishing access uses role-based business accounts and is removed when the engagement ends.

application.how_to_apply: Share one calendar you managed and explain how you decided what to adapt by platform.

screening.prompt: What would you report beyond follower growth for a recipe account?

jobs.title: Community manager for a thoughtful podcast membership
jobs.about: Harborlight's fictional membership brings listeners and guests together for monthly conversations. We need calm moderation, useful prompts, and dependable escalation rather than engagement for its own sake.
responsibilities: Moderate member discussions and respond within agreed hours
Plan two useful prompts and one member session each week
Escalate safety, privacy, and guest-boundary concerns promptly
requirements: Experience moderating a paid or professional community
Strong written empathy and boundary setting
Comfort documenting recurring questions and incidents

deliverables.notes: Facilitate, do not produce, the member session.

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Moderation permissions are role-scoped; member exports and personal credentials are not shared.

application.how_to_apply: Describe one difficult moderation decision and the policy or principle you used.

screening.prompt: How would you respond when a paying member repeatedly crosses a guest's stated boundary?

jobs.title: Creator assistant for research, scheduling, and production follow-through
jobs.about: Startup Stories needs a detail-oriented assistant who can protect the creator's focus while keeping a small editorial system moving. The role combines scheduling, meeting notes, research logistics, and production follow-up—not video editing or social media ownership.
responsibilities: Maintain the creator's production-aware calendar
Prepare agendas, decision notes, and follow-up lists
Coordinate research interviews and asset permissions
requirements: Experience supporting a creator, founder, or small media team

engagement.timezone_overlap: Four hours with IST on weekdays

deliverables.notes: Calendar, decisions, open loops, and next actions.

application.how_to_apply: Share a concise example of how you turned a messy week into a dependable operating plan.

screening.prompt: What information do you need before moving a creator's production deadline?

jobs.title: Content operations manager for a six-month documentary slate
jobs.about: Orbit Eight Studio is producing six short science documentaries with distributed researchers, writers, editors, and designers. This fixed-term role owns sequencing, dependencies, review windows, and a humane production rhythm.
responsibilities: Build and maintain the slate plan and dependency map
Run weekly production reviews and document decisions
Surface scope or schedule risks before they become emergencies

engagement.timezone_overlap: Two Mumbai studio days each week

application.how_to_apply: Share a complex creative project plan and one example of how you reduced production risk.

screening.prompt: How do you respond when research expands after the edit schedule is locked?

jobs.title: Creator partnerships manager for transparent beauty campaigns
jobs.about: Kinfolk coordinates fictional beauty campaigns with mid-sized creators. This role owns partner sourcing, briefing, approvals, and reporting while keeping deliverables, usage rights, and payment expectations explicit.
responsibilities: Build campaign creator shortlists with clear rationale
Coordinate briefs, approvals, usage terms, and delivery dates
Report campaign outcomes and partner feedback
requirements: Working knowledge of paid social usage terms

compensation.note: USD 52,000 annual base plus a documented quarterly bonus tied to campaign quality, delivery, and client retention—not creator fee reductions.

engagement.timezone_overlap: Core overlap with US Eastern mornings

deliverables.notes: From shortlist through closeout.

application.how_to_apply: Use the fictional Kinfolk demo form and describe one campaign trade-off you made transparently.

screening.prompt: How do you prevent usage-rights ambiguity before a creator starts work?
Walk us through how you scope, brief, and track a multi-creator campaign end to end.
Share one partnership that underperformed and what you changed afterwards.

jobs.title: UGC creator for honest pantry-product demonstrations
jobs.about: Goodgrain is commissioning a small set of creator-led product demonstrations for its fictional pantry range. Videos should show real preparation steps, include required disclosures, and avoid unsupported health claims.
responsibilities: Develop a simple concept from the approved product brief
Film and edit platform-safe demonstrations in a home kitchen
Deliver clean masters, captioned versions, and source footage
requirements: A portfolio of natural product demonstrations
Strong mobile lighting and clean audio
Comfort following disclosure and claim guidance

deliverables.notes: Three distinct 20–35 second product demonstrations with organic-use rights defined in the brief.

jobs.source_inputs_notes: Products are shipped by the fictional brand; the creator does not purchase samples.

application.how_to_apply: Share two honest product demonstrations and note what you filmed and edited yourself.

screening.prompt: How do you keep a sponsored product demonstration credible?

jobs.title: Graphic designer for an indie gaming channel identity refresh
jobs.about: Indie Gamer needs a practical visual refresh that works across weekly uploads, live streams, and Discord. The goal is a compact system the creator can maintain, not an oversized brand exercise.
responsibilities: Refresh the channel banner, stream cards, and reusable social templates
Define a compact typography, color, and asset guide
Hand off editable files with a short recorded walkthrough
requirements: A portfolio of flexible digital identity systems
Strong hierarchy for gaming or entertainment content

deliverables.notes: One compact brand kit plus 10 editable production templates.

application.how_to_apply: Share one identity system that a small client could maintain without a designer on staff.

screening.prompt: What would you include in a minimum viable creator brand kit?

jobs.title: On-site videographer for a three-day coastal travel shoot
jobs.about: Roamline is filming a fictional coastal guide built around local transport, food systems, and public spaces. We need a self-directed camera operator who can work respectfully with a small producer and capture useful natural sound.
responsibilities: Capture interviews, observational B-roll, and location sound
Follow shot priorities while adapting to access and weather
Back up and label media at the end of each shoot day
requirements: Own or reliable access to a compact 4K camera and audio kit
Comfort working on foot for full shoot days

compensation.note: Travel within the fictional shoot region, accommodation, and approved equipment rentals are covered separately.

deliverables.notes: Three shoot days with nightly verified backups and logs.

other_required_tools: Compact 4K camera and field audio kit

application.how_to_apply: Share a field-production reel, your compact kit list, and confirmation that you can work locally in Lisbon.

screening.prompt: How do you keep media safe during a small location shoot?

jobs.title: Newsletter writer for a weekly creator-business briefing
jobs.about: Startup Stories is extending its original case-study reporting into a concise weekly newsletter. The writer will turn approved reporting and interview notes into useful analysis for independent creators and small media teams.
responsibilities: Draft one tightly structured briefing each week
Verify claims against supplied reporting and source links
Collaborate on subject lines and post-send learning notes
requirements: Published newsletter or business writing samples

deliverables.notes: Approximately 1,200–1,600 edited words.

application.how_to_apply: Share two analytical writing samples and one sentence on how you avoid overstating a case study.

screening.prompt: What makes a creator-business case study useful rather than merely inspirational?

jobs.title: Audio engineer for weekly interview podcast mastering
jobs.about: Harborlight needs consistent dialogue cleanup and mastering for a weekly show recorded across treated studios and remote guest setups. The focus is intelligibility, natural voices, and predictable technical delivery.
responsibilities: Clean dialogue while preserving natural room tone
Mix intros, music, ads, and guest tracks to the show standard
Deliver mastered WAV and platform files with a brief issue log
requirements: Dialogue repair and podcast mastering samples
Clear communication when a recording cannot be repaired cleanly

deliverables.notes: One 45–70 minute mastered episode plus issue log.

other_required_tools: iZotope RX or equivalent repair tools

application.how_to_apply: Share a dialogue cleanup before-and-after and your standard podcast delivery specs.

screening.prompt: When would you escalate a recording problem instead of applying heavier repair?

jobs.title: Affiliate campaign copywriter for creator-led product launches
jobs.about: Kinfolk is assembling a small bench of copywriters for fictional creator affiliate launches. Compensation is genuinely negotiable because scope ranges from a short brief review to a complete multi-platform copy package; commission terms are documented before work starts.
responsibilities: Write clear disclosure-forward campaign copy
Adapt approved claims for creator voice and platform constraints
Document variants and approvals in the campaign workspace
requirements: Commercial copy samples with transparent claims
Experience adapting a brief without flattening creator voice
Comfort reviewing written commission terms before accepting work

compensation.note: Each assignment includes a written guaranteed minimum plus a percentage of attributable net sales; exact minimum, percentage, tracking window, and payment schedule are agreed before acceptance.

deliverables.notes: Typical package includes one video brief, three captions, and an email section.

application.how_to_apply: Share one disclosure-forward campaign sample and the questions you ask before accepting commission-based work.

screening.prompt: Which commission terms must be explicit before you begin writing?

jobs.title: Content planning intern for seasonal recipe research
jobs.about: Goodgrain is drafting a supervised internship focused on seasonal recipe research and content planning. The listing remains a draft while the team confirms mentorship hours and the final learning plan.
responsibilities: Support seasonal topic research
Organize audience questions into planning notes
requirements: Clear research notes and reliable communication

application.how_to_apply: Draft listing—not visible in public discovery.

jobs.title: 2D animator for a climate explainer sequence
jobs.about: Orbit Eight paused this fictional assignment while the underlying storyboard is revised. The complete owner-side fixture remains available for status and preview testing but must never enter public discovery.
responsibilities: Animate supplied boards into a coherent sequence

application.how_to_apply: Paused fixture—not visible in public discovery.

jobs.title: Paid media specialist for a completed creator course launch
jobs.about: Northstar closed this fictional campaign after completing its hiring cycle. It remains in the deterministic owner fixture to exercise closed-state presentation and public exclusion.
responsibilities: Plan and monitor a short creator launch campaign
jobs.source_inputs_notes: Role-based campaign access only; no personal credentials.

application.how_to_apply: Closed fixture—not visible in public discovery.
